In the shadow of mount Greb stood a smaller mountain. Koniguldon. Leader of the expedition. At four metres tall, Koniguldon towered over the Hag and his cart. 'I have come to trade oh masterful smith' said the Hag. 'My people have need of weapons. Swords, spears and shields.'

'Strange' said Koniguldon. 'I know not of Shryke that use swords and shields'. 'Well' coughed the Hag, shifting in his seat 'times are changing, and I bring something highly prized by the Holnareem.' With that, the Hag stood in his seat, and lifted the tarp behind him. 'Salt!' He shouted.

'I can make weekly deliveries, brought straight from the sea. Salt for weapons. What say you Koniguldon?'
